summary: Fortress Net Lease REIT filed an 8-K reporting the sale of 10,853,532 common shares for $113.6 million in gross proceeds, priced at April 30, 2026 net asset value per share (Class S $47.8M, Class I $50.5M, Class F-S $1.5M, Class F-I $12.8M, Class E $1.1M). The offering was exempt under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D and/or Regulation S. Separately, the board declared per-share distributions payable June 1, 2026. This is a routine capital raise and distribution declaration—not a special situation.
